lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
The neon sign flickers in the night
Coffee steam rises in the golden light
The floorboards creak with every heavy stride
There is nowhere left for the rhythm to hide
[Pre-Chorus]
Grab your seat and hold on tight
The music's gonna set the soul alight
[Chorus]
Swing your heart into the middle of the floor
Give the spirit a little bit more
Shake the dust off your heavy boots
Let the melody take you to the roots
[Verse]
Old records spinning on a dusty wheel
Finding out exactly how the good times feel
The jukebox hums a sweet, low tune
Dancing under the light of a paper moon
[Pre-Chorus]
Close your eyes and let it flow
Catch the spark before the fires go
[Chorus]
Swing your heart into the middle of the floor
Give the spirit a little bit more
Shake the dust off your heavy boots
Let the melody take you to the roots
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
No more waiting, no more stalling now
Just the magic of the rhythm's bow
[Chorus]
Swing your heart into the middle of the floor
Give the spirit a little bit more
Shake the dust off your heavy boots
Let the melody take you to the roots
[Outro]
